_documentation.model_purpose: Conditional probability, kinematic return, and time-store transition fact store for S5V Volume Breadth Triad. Quantifies institutional participation, volume persistence, and volume exhaustion across structural (TH 50v>200v), intermediate (FI 20v>50v), and tactical (TW EMA5v>20v) volume breadth states.
_documentation.return_formula: ev_net = (P_bull * E[ret_max] + P_bear * E[ret_min]) - 0.0010 (10 bps round-trip friction deducted)
_documentation.state_hierarchy: L0: Global macro (13 canonical entities), L1: Volatility Tiers (Defensive, Mixed, Cyclical, High-Beta, SPY), L2: Individual Sectors (XLK, XLF, etc., exposed if N >= 20). Prefixes: R4 (4D), R3 (3D), R2 (2D), R1 (1D).

bin_classification.method: Empirical population percentiles [0.10, 0.30, 0.70, 0.90] across all 13 canonical entities

dimension_thresholds_definition.TH: Structural volume breadth: % of S&P 500 stocks with SMA(50,vol) > SMA(200,vol).
dimension_thresholds_definition.FI: Intermediate volume breadth: % of S&P 500 stocks with SMA(20,vol) > SMA(50,vol).
dimension_thresholds_definition.TW: Tactical volume breadth: % of S&P 500 stocks with EMA(5,vol) > SMA(20,vol).
dimension_thresholds_definition.Direction: Kinematic velocity direction of tactical volume breadth (+/-).

field_glossary.n: Historical observation count (trading days) in this state.
field_glossary.P_bot_X_Y: Empirical probability of being near a ZigZag X.Y% bottom (preceding by <= 3 days).
field_glossary.P_top_X_Y: Empirical probability of being near a ZigZag X.Y% top (preceding by <= 3 days).
field_glossary.lift_bot_5_0: P_bot_5_0 / global baseline. > 1.0 indicates accumulation zone.
field_glossary.lift_top_5_0: P_top_5_0 / global baseline. > 1.0 indicates distribution zone.
field_glossary.net_bias: P_bot_5_0 - P_top_5_0. Positive = net accumulation, negative = net distribution.
field_glossary.n_episodes: Count of distinct contiguous time-series episodes in this state.
field_glossary.pct_tiempo: Fraction of total historical trading days spent in this state.
field_glossary.duration_mean: Mean Sojourn Time (average episode duration in trading days).
field_glossary.duration_max: Maximum observed continuous stay in this state.
field_glossary.fatigue_buckets: Decay of forward expected return across persistence stages (fresh, persist, mature, exhaustion).
field_glossary.pct_en_rango: Fraction of observations within ±2 bars of an inflection turn.
field_glossary.pct_fuera: Fraction of observations outside turn window (in directional inertia).
field_glossary.delta_mediana_barras: Median signed bar distance to nearest turn.
field_glossary.slots_canonicos: Observation distribution across canonical timing slots: t-2, t-1, t=0, entre.
field_glossary.p_bull: Probability of next swing reaching upper pivot (MAX), shrunk via Laplace Bayesian Shrinkage (M=10).
field_glossary.p_bear: Probability of next swing reaching lower pivot (MIN).
field_glossary.ev_net: Net expected return of subsequent swing, net of 10 bps friction.
field_glossary.e_days: Expected trading days to reach target pivot.
field_glossary.ev_per_day: Capital velocity (% net return per day committed).
field_glossary.confidence_tier: Four-tier confidence rating based on sample size and expected return (Diamond, Gold, Silver, Bronze).

_documentation.signal_interpretation_policy: Clean Architecture Standard: Business signals (ALLOW, REDUCE, ACCUMULATE, TRIM) are NOT static strings in this JSON, but are dynamically interpreted by pure-domain adapters (triad_lookup.py, quality_entry_gate.py).
